arm_headers.voo: MedDiet with VOO vs. control diet

analysis.selection: All two overall models and three contrasts, irrespective of direction or null inclusion. Subgroup rows not extracted or pooled in this protocol.
analysis.source_comparison: Compare the three original-row point/CI tuples in correction Table3 against original Table2; retain disagreement and fail source reproduction if not exact.
analysis.uncertainty: Retain reported intervals without turning them into a sampling distribution; shared participants/control and original/corrected analyses are dependent, with joint covariance unavailable.
analysis.unit: dimensionless adjusted Cox hazard ratio for first incident diabetes

chronology: Frozen after primary article, correction, headers, row labels and prior published-result appraisal; before executable effect-cell extraction and new synthetic compatibility calculations. Used-source reproduction, not preregistration or independent validation.

compatibility_diagnostic.dose_lag_witness: L(t)=beta*delta*[1-exp(-t/tau)] through relax. Dose/coefficient rescaling (delta/scale,beta*scale,tau) preserves the trajectory. Lag/coefficient rescaling (delta,beta*[1-exp(-1/tau)]/[1-exp(-1/(scale*tau))],scale*tau) preserves year1 but changes year2.
compatibility_diagnostic.endpoint_witness: Normalize existing synthetic H/IR shares, D0=0. A=(a,r,d/scale), pA=dA/(rA+dA)*[-expm1(-(rA+dA))]. B has gB=scale*(rA+dA), dB=pA*gB/[-expm1(-gB)], rB=gB-dB, unchanged a. C changes only a to scale*a. Test same year1 D entry, different endpoint stocks/year2 entries, conservation and analytic arithmetic.
compatibility_diagnostic.limitation: Counterexamples concern the isolated implemented annual survivor operator and synthetic dietary response. They are not formal identifiability results for the trial multi-year adjusted Cox likelihood; the source HR is never used as a one-year risk ratio or input to these witnesses.
compatibility_diagnostic.null: Identical hazards reproduce reference output; zero response gives multiplier one. Mathematical hypotheses, not observed zero clinical effects.
compatibility_diagnostic.uncertainty: Fixed mathematical/software witnesses; not clinical estimates or clinical uncertainty distributions.
compatibility_diagnostic.units: hazards per year; lag/time in years; normalized expected person counts and dimensionless log-response

limits: Separate Reus original/correction, not the unretrieved multicenter Annals correction; do not substitute cardiovascular corrections.
Regimen counseling plus provided foods is not an isolated UPF, fiber or ingredient contrast.
The reported adjusted Cox analysis includes weight change during the study; a total causal regimen effect cannot be asserted automatically.
Original and correction adjustment footnotes differ on age/sex; preserve the discrepancy instead of harmonizing it.
No full source redistribution or participant records; factual estimates, citations, receipts and original code only.
#58 and all original scientific acceptance requirements remain open; expert review pending.
